jobs_list.job_statement: When I'm managing a real estate transaction, I want to coordinate multiple service providers seamlessly, so I can close my deal efficiently and with less stress
jobs_list.current_solutions: Manual coordination, phone calls, emails, basic project management tools

jobs_list.job_statement: When I'm making real estate decisions, I want to access advanced technology platforms, so I can have better insights and control over the process
jobs_list.current_solutions: Industry-standard tools, basic property websites, spreadsheets

jobs_list.job_statement: When I'm tracking my real estate journey, I want to have clear visibility of all steps and requirements, so I can feel confident about my progress
jobs_list.current_solutions: Paper checklists, fragmented digital tools, agent updates

jobs_list.job_statement: When I'm managing my family's housing needs, I want to make informed decisions within my budget, so I can balance quality and cost
jobs_list.current_solutions: Traditional agent services, online research, word-of-mouth

jobs_list.job_statement: When I'm working with service providers, I want to understand fee structures clearly, so I can make cost-effective choices
jobs_list.current_solutions: Standard commission structures, basic fee breakdowns

jtbd_data.methodology: Customer interviews, pain point analysis, and opportunity scoring
